Westpac Reports Decline in Home Loan Applications

Westpac has reported a 20% decrease in home loan applications following the recent budget announcement. Despite this decline in mortgage applications, the bank's quarterly profits have seen an increase. The Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) is anticipated to reach a new record high, mirroring a similar trend on Wall Street where the S&P 500 also closed at a record.
